name: favourite-ring-wears-the-icon-colour-in-glass
description: The selected favourite tile rings in its favicon's own colour, graded against the tile as painted so it clears 3:1. Glass look: the fixture's Dark space is tinted #12282E and its one favourite carries a solid red icon. The space holds no tab on the favourite's URL: a restored tab never claims a tile, so the tile only selects when the click opens the page itself. The read is the ring element's ::after border against the tile's background composited over the space tint.

actions.note: the only favourite tile, at a sibling scenario's coordinates. The click OPENS and CLAIMS the tab, which is what selects the tile.
the favourite has no live tab, so the click opens and claims one. The page spins for 3s, so this outlasts the load and the icon fetch

actions.expression: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.fav.sel'); if (!t) { return 'no selected tile'; } const b = t.querySelector(':scope > .brdr'); if (!b) { return 'no ring element'; } const after = getComputedStyle(b, '::after'); const html = document.documentElement; return JSON.stringify({inline: t.style.getPropertyValue('--ringb'), ring: getComputedStyle(t).getPropertyValue('--ringb').trim(), border: after.borderTopColor, width: after.borderTopWidth, opacity: getComputedStyle(b).opacity + '/' + after.opacity, native: html.classList.contains('atrium-native-chrome'), surround: html.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color'), tile: getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor, selbase: getComputedStyle(t).getPropertyValue('--selbase').trim(), icon: !!t.querySelector('.fvimg.ok')}); })()

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('.fav.sel'); if (!t) { return 'no selected tile'; } const b = t.querySelector(':scope > .brdr'); if (!b) { return 'no ring element'; } const rgba = (raw) => { const s = (raw || '').trim(); const h = /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/.exec(s); if (h) { return [0, 2, 4].map((i) => parseInt(h[1].substr(i, 2), 16)).concat(1); } const m = /^rgba?\(([^)]*)\)/.exec(s); const n = m && m[1].match(/[0-9.]+/g); if (!n || n.length < 3) { return null; } return [Number(n[0]), Number(n[1]), Number(n[2]), n.length > 3 ? Number(n[3]) : 1]; }; const lin = (v) => { const c = v / 255; return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); }; const lum = (c) => 0.2126 * lin(c[0]) + 0.7152 * lin(c[1]) + 0.0722 * lin(c[2]); const html = document.documentElement; const native = html.classList.contains('atrium-native-chrome'); const base = rgba(native ? html.style.getPropertyValue('--atrium-surround-color') : getComputedStyle(t).getPropertyValue('--selbase')); const ring = rgba(getComputedStyle(b, '::after').borderTopColor); if (!ring || !base) { return 'unreadable'; } const wash = rgba(getComputedStyle(t).backgroundColor); const ground = wash && wash[3] > 0 ? [0, 1, 2].map((i) => Math.round(base[i] * (1 - wash[3]) + wash[i] * wash[3])) : base.slice(0, 3); const a = lum(ring); const g = lum(ground); const ratio = (Math.max(a, g) + 0.05) / (Math.min(a, g) + 0.05); const red = ring[0] > 150 && ring[0] - ring[1] > 40 && ring[0] - ring[2] > 40; return (red ? 'red' : 'not red ' + ring.slice(0, 3).join(',')) + (ratio >= 3 ? ' clears 3:1' : ' faint ' + ratio.toFixed(2) + ' on ' + ground.join(',')); })()
